  (bit : (b : Bool) → (n : ℕ) → motive n → motive (Nat.bit b n)) 
  (n : ℕ) : motive n := 
  if n = 0 then 
    zero 
  else 
    let m := n / 2 
    let b : Bool := (n % 2 = 1).decide 
    let prev := VTask.binaryRec zero bit m 
    bit b m prev 
  using_well_founded 
    { dec_tac := 
        `[ 
          apply Nat.div_lt_self, 
          decide, 
          decide, 
          decide 
        ] 
    }
